shots.character_action: Astronaut stickman floats beside spacecraft and turns toward camera.
shots.camera: Slow push-in with subtle orbital parallax.

shots.narration: An explosion happens nearby. Why might you hear nothing?
shots.character_action: Distant non-graphic flash; astronaut reacts and raises one hand.
shots.camera: Wide shot with brief light pulse.

shots.narration: Sound needs something to travel through. Space is almost a vacuum.
shots.character_action: Stickman points to animated wave diagram.
shots.camera: Side view; wave lines stop at vacuum boundary.

shots.narration: The explosion can be spectacular to see, but silent to an astronaut outside the ship.
shots.character_action: Astronaut looks toward flash then gestures toward helmet.
